skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply specialized knowledge on commercial business management to solve practical problems.
Apply specialized knowledge on international trade to solve practical problems.
Apply specialized knowledge on customs regulations to solve practical problems.
Demonstrate negotiation skills in commercial transactions.
Perform basic operations in commercial business, trade management, international trade, customs, logistics, supply chain management, and e-commerce.
Manage commercial businesses and services with various business skills.
Utilize, synthesize, analyze, and evaluate business data and information to solve issues in international trade.
Manage international trade activities, develop, implement, and control business plans in international trade.
Utilize, synthesize, analyze, and evaluate data and information to solve issues in customs.
Evaluate economic and social impacts of regulations in national management of customs.
Demonstrate independence and responsibility when working alone and within a team.
Express and defend personal views based on an objective and scientific approach.

prerequisite_courses: Required courses for the International Business major
